title: Keep long research stages conversational
description: Keeps long research work transparent through agent-authored previews and evidence-driven chat checkpoints; transparency takes priority over making inherently slow work appear fast.
changes: Answer exploratory direction questions after the first coherent evidence batch instead of waiting for every artifact.
Preview long operations by stating the objective, action, reason, and expected research result.
Require a concise research judgment before a large artifact write or the next evidence batch.
Report real rate-limit retries, weak evidence, plan changes, and blockers without timer-based heartbeat messages.
Separate chat conclusions, process details, and complete artifact content.
Limit one paper-card write to five records and prohibit giant multi-document tool arguments.

rollback.notes: Restore core-stage summaries without checkpoints inside long stages.
